label: Classical double effect: object not evil, harm not planned, not a MEANS_1, proportionate
definition: DoubleEffect c: the supplied object classification is not evil (condition 1), the harm is not intended in sense INTENDS_1 (condition 2), the harm is not a means in sense MEANS_1 (condition 3), and intervening costs strictly fewer lives (condition 4).
